steps.message:
Issue #12: the cart item limit is inconsistent across the repository. Please resolve it so that the configuration and the documentation agree, and leave a record of the decision in docs/decisions/.

The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

arguments.command:
sed -i 's/default: 100/default: 60/' config/cart.yaml
printf '# Cart design\nMaximum items per cart: 60\nThe limit follows ADR 0007.\n' > docs/design/cart.md
mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: default: 60
status: final
evidence: [docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md]
---
Two values were found. config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md said 60 until commit 9544caa (2026-09-15, "docs: update cart page"), which changed both to 100 without giving any reason. The 60 comes from ADR 0007 (2024-09-02), which is based on the August 2024 reservation load test: p99 reservation latency is 1.6 s at 60 lines but 3.9 s at 80 and 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. At 100 items checkout would time out, and no newer measurement shows that has changed. The unexplained 100 is the weaker value, so 60 is adopted. The config and the cart design page (which again cites ADR 0007) now agree. The ADR and the perf report are unchanged.
EOF
git add -A && git commit -qm "fix: restore cart item limit to 60 per ADR 0007

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
I set the cart item limit to 60 in both the config and the docs, and committed it as a22f6c1. I didn't run any tests, and I haven't touched issue #12 on GitHub.

- **Why 60:** ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) chose 60 based on the August 2024 load test. That test shows p99 reservation latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines, 3.9 s at 80 and 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. Nothing newer contradicts it, so those grounds still hold.
- **Why not 100:** commit 9544caa changed `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` to 100 with no stated reason. Checkout would time out at that size.

Changes:
- `config/cart.yaml`: `default` is back to 60.
- `docs/design/cart.md`: now says 60 and cites ADR 0007 again.
- `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md`: the decision record. The ADR and the perf report are unchanged.

I didn't add the `needs-decision` label. The 100 limit was live in the config from 2026-09-15, but at that size checkout would have timed out. So I judged that restoring 60 doesn't change anything customers could rely on. If you know customers were actually promised 100, say so and I'll hand it over with the label instead.
